# Stripe fixtures

These are the unmodified `payment_intent`, `charge`, `invoice`, `refund`,
`dispute`, `balance_transaction` and `payout` examples from `openapi/fixtures3.json`
in [stripe/openapi](https://github.com/stripe/openapi) (MIT), at commit
`af5309cae53e5f666f9686dfed306d6d3b5fdc67`, whose specification is version
`2026-07-29.dahlia`, the version this package pins. They are placeholder
examples: the IDs and the client secret belong to no account.
